1.d4 d5 2.c4 c5 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.Nc3.strategy: A natural developing move that puts a second attacker on d5 and asks Black to settle the centre. White commits no pawn yet and keeps the option of exchanging on d5 or on c5 depending on how Black reinforces the centre.

1.d4 d5 2.c4 c5 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.Nc3 e6.strategy: Reinforces d5 and opens the dark-squared bishop. The idea is that Black can retake on d5 with the knight rather than a pawn, avoiding an isolated pawn, at the price of giving White the freer position.
